clock_boundary: All inputs synchronous to clk_rf. clk_ctrl requests/configuration require external existing atomic mailbox/CDC; normalized hardware feedback requires board-specific CDC before these ports.
physical_binding: binding_valid must originate from validated trusted board adapter, never a raw software enable. Current production binding remains UNBOUND. Simulation fixture asserting binding_valid is not production validation.

rf.sequence: RX -> protect feedback plus dwell -> T/R TX feedback plus dwell -> PA feedback plus dwell -> unmute. Stop -> mute and PA off -> PA-off feedback plus recovery dwell -> T/R RX -> RX feedback plus recovery dwell -> release protection.
rf.timing_inputs: protect_cycles, switch_cycles, pa_cycles, recovery_cycles, transition_timeout_cycles, watchdog_cycles: unsigned u32 clk_rf cycle counts; validated and held stable while armed. Zero dwell permitted; timeout/watchdog must be nonzero.
rf.faults: hard_fault, armed PLL loss, watchdog expiry, transition timeout and TX feedback loss latch. Disarmed clear_fault with healthy hard-fault/PLL/timing permits explicit clear. UNBOUND independently inhibits all PA enable.
rf.heartbeat: One synchronous event per upstream software-heartbeat transaction. Must not be tied high or generated autonomously while Linux is stalled.
rf.arming: SAFE enters RX only with arm high, tx_request low and normalized PA-off/T-R-RX feedback. A pending TX request does not auto-start after fault recovery.
rf.clock_loss: Clock disappearance needs independent physical shutdown hardware; logical combinational inhibiting does not certify an asynchronous safety circuit.

aux.scope: Paired H/V ADC3 and ADC7 analog source only; fixed MID range; no primary-six-lane or ADC/DDC/FIR stop/reset signals.
aux.commit: Idle, bound, valid timing and safe_to_switch required; reject invalid role, unsafe or busy requests. Every accepted commit increments u32 source_epoch and invalidates AUX, including repeated role.
aux.qualification: Matching normalized source_ack/source_feedback -> settling clk_rf cycles -> flush_samples sample_tick events -> done. source_active changes only on matching feedback. SAFE completes with aux_valid false.
aux.timing: Unsigned u32 settling_cycles in clk_rf cycles, switch_timeout_cycles in clk_rf cycles, flush_samples in output sample intervals. Latched at accepted commit. PL flush minimum 42 plus board-defined RFDC history/measured pipeline must be included in supplied flush_samples; analog settling independently supplied.
aux.invalidity: Reset, transition, binding/timing loss, switch timeout all deny aux_valid. Missing hardware never reports valid. rejected and done are one-cycle pulses. drop_count saturates u32 on sample_tick while invalid.
aux.integration: source_ack must reflect stable actual paired source state, not software request acceptance. Frame source_role requires channel_roles.json mapping, not direct register enum copy. Calibration validity remains a separate qualifier.
